videos.title: Watch How Two Friends Started This Business
videos.description:
At just 22 years old, Marathi friends Saurabh and Jayesh started “Aapla Jalgaonwala”, a startup with a dream to make Khandesh’s famous banana wafers known across India and eventually the world.

Building and successfully establishing this business in Pune was far from easy. They faced numerous challenges while focusing on high-quality wafers, hygienic production, premium packaging, and ensuring that the flavors stayed fresh for a long time.

Today, their banana chips made from bananas sourced from their farms in Jalgaon have gained popularity across Pune, Maharashtra, and different parts of India.

“My Soil, My Country... Jai Khandesh!”

Born from the soil of Khandesh, Aapla Jalgaonwala Enterprises is a perfect blend of taste, purity, and trust.

With 10+ exciting wafers flavors, the brand is now expanding its distribution across Maharashtra.
videos.speaker: Saurabh Patil & Jayesh Patil

videos.title: An Incredible Story of Two Friends
videos.description:
Two young men from Khandesh have built a chips brand called “Aapla Jalgaon Wala” in Pune. Their journey has truly been filled with struggle and challenges. Even after establishing their brand, they are currently managing both their jobs and their business side by side.

This video is a salute to their incredible hard work and determination. They share how they built their chips brand, the challenges they faced along the way, and how they currently manage both their jobs and business together.

The entire journey and their experiences are discussed in detail in this video.
videos.speaker: Jayesh Patil (Co-Founder)

videos.title: Famous Khandeshi Banana Chips
videos.description:
Saurabh and Jayesh, two young engineers from Khandesh, Jalgaon, have started an innovative business producing banana chips in a variety of delicious flavors and selling them online across Maharashtra.

Their entrepreneurial journey has grown so rapidly that their business is now being talked about across the state. Today, these two engineers are successfully running their business with great dedication and professionalism.

One of the biggest highlights of their business is that customers from any corner of Maharashtra can easily order their banana chips online, with delivery charges kept very affordable. And most importantly, their banana chips are known for their delicious taste and quality.

This banana chips business, started by two young Marathi entrepreneurs, is not only helping them become self-reliant, but is also creating inspiration and opportunities for many other young people to enter entrepreneurship.

Looking at the journey of these two young entrepreneurs, it is clear that their story has the potential to change the way many youngsters look at business and entrepreneurship.
videos.speaker: Aapla Jalgaonwala Team
